quality.task_confirmation: Movement consistency checks only; task identity and completion require human review.

gait_late_to_early_range_ratio.label: Gait late to early range ratio

coordinate_system.landmarks: Image-normalized x/right, y/down and relative z/toward camera for smaller values. Hip/wrist-relative depth has no global camera-position origin.
coordinate_system.world_landmarks: MediaPipe estimated meters around hips/hand center; model estimates only, not calibrated clinical distances.
coordinate_system.viewer: World XYZ only: x/right, inverted y/up, z/away. Native estimated-meter scale and model-local origin. No image-plane depth fallback or global walking route.

model_provenance: Google MediaPipe Pose Landmarker Lite / Hand Landmarker; unvalidated task-specific feature extraction
limitations: Arm-swing measurement is unavailable because both arms could not be tracked reliably. Keep both shoulders and wrists visible throughout the recording if this measurement is needed.
caveats: Single RGB camera landmarks are approximate. These measures are monitoring proxies, not a diagnosis or a validated clinical score.
Camera distance, view, clothing and lighting affect comparisons. Match setup and task duration to the baseline.
Left/right classification expects unmirrored input; confirm the anatomical side before saving.
